name: Trabajador Residente -- Dependiente (Employer-Sponsored Worker)

requirements.blocker_text: A written employment contract, registered and approved by the Ministry of Labour (MTPE), is required before applying to MIGRACIONES.
requirements.fix_path: Secure a job offer and have the employer register the contract with the MTPE.

requirements.blocker_text: Foreign employees generally cannot exceed 20% of the employer's total workforce, and their combined salaries cannot exceed 30% of total payroll. Citizens of Andean Community countries (Bolivia, Colombia, Ecuador) are exempt from this cap.
Interpol international police clearance certificate (valid up to 6 months) and criminal/judicial background clearance from the country of origin covering the preceding 5 years.

evidence_required.document: Criminal/judicial background clearance from country of origin (5-year coverage)

sources.title: Superintendencia Nacional de Migraciones (MIGRACIONES) -- Reglamento del Decreto Legislativo N.1350, Article 29.2.h: Trabajador resident immigration status (subordinate or independent lucrative work), 365 days
Veninformado -- Trabajador resident status: MTPE-approved contract requirement, 20% foreign-workforce / 30% payroll cap with Andean Community exemption, Interpol clearance, annual renewal

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Peru). STATUS: DRAFT -- the category itself and its 365-day duration are tier-1 (direct from the MIGRACIONES regulation, Art. 29.2.h), but the MTPE-contract mechanics, the 20%/30% workforce cap, and the specific Interpol/background-check documentation come only from a tier-3 consultancy source, not an independently fetched MTPE or MIGRACIONES procedural page (gob.pe pages were bot-blocked on every fetch attempt in this pass). work_rights is 'restricted' because employment is tied to the specific MTPE-approved contract underlying the permit, not an open work authorization. The 20%/30% foreign-workforce cap (D. Leg. 689) is a genuinely distinctive Peru-specific constraint not seen in most other countries built in this dataset -- flagged prominently since it can independently block an otherwise-qualified applicant if the employer's existing foreign headcount is already at the cap. This is the DEPENDIENTE (employer-sponsored) modality of the single 'Trabajador' calidad migratoria; see pe_work_independent.json for the same legal category's self-employed modality, which is far more thinly documented.
